description: University Grants Commission - Amendment of the Postgraduate Institute of Management Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette content contains the full text of an ordinance (the Postgraduate Institute of Management Ordinance, No. 03 of 2018) made by the University Grants Commission under the Universities Act. It establishes legal frameworks, powers, and administrative structures for the institute. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
